packageRules.description: Pin the example compose files' Nextcloud image to 33.x (astrolabe's min-version); bump this when min-version moves

@playwright/test is pinned to match the Chromium browser revision installed in CI and local dev. Updating requires verifying that the new version's expected browser revision is available. See: ~/.cache/ms-playwright/ for installed revisions.
Keep next and @next/mdx (and other @next/* packages) on the same version — they are released in lockstep and must stay aligned.
Keep @mdx-js/* aligned with @next/mdx — @next/mdx pins a peer range on these, so update them together to avoid peer-dep drift.

Keep react, react-dom and their @types on the same version across website/ and docs/ — they are released in lockstep, and grouping also folds the in-range lockfile-only updates into the same PR instead of one per package file.
Keep fumadocs-core, fumadocs-ui and fumadocs-mdx on the same version — fumadocs-ui pins a peer range on fumadocs-core, so update them together in one PR.

customManagers.description: commitizen pinned in the bump-version workflow (pre-commit's own rev is managed by the pre-commit manager)
